# Capabilities

<!-- Generated by scripts/capabilities-doc.mjs from each plugin's `catalog`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every role below is optional except a work source and a code host. Turn on the ones your team has;
for each one left off, **When off** says what the Foreman does instead. `npm run doctor` checks the result.

| Plugin | Roles | On when |
|---|---|---|
| GitHub (`github`) | `workSource`, `codeHost` | `workSource` / `codeHost` is `github` (the default) |
| Paperclip (`paperclip`) | `observer` | `paperclip.enabled`, with `companyId` and `agentId` |
| Metrics (`metrics`) | `observer` | `metrics.enabled` |
| Tech Lead (`tech-lead`) | `reviewer` | `techLeadPath` is set (and `reviewEnabled` turns the review stage on) |
| SRE (`sre`) | `verifier`, `deployer` | `srePath` is set |
| QA (`qa`) | `qa` | `qaPath` is set (covers `qaRepos`) |
| Unstick (EM) (`em`) | `unstick` | `emRepoPath` is set |

## GitHub (`github`)

Reads the issues to build (work source) and opens, reads and merges pull requests (code host).

- **Roles:** `workSource`, `codeHost`
- **On when:** `workSource` / `codeHost` is `github` (the default)
- **Config:** `workSource`, `codeHost`, `repos[].githubRepo`
- **Env:** `FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN`
- **When off:** Nothing runs: GitHub is the only built-in work source and code host, so there are no issues to build and nowhere to open a PR.

## Paperclip (`paperclip`)

Mirrors each issue onto a Paperclip board card and posts handoffs there for the people or agents who act next.

- **Roles:** `observer`
- **On when:** `paperclip.enabled`, with `companyId` and `agentId`
- **Config:** `paperclip.enabled`, `paperclip.url`, `paperclip.companyId`, `paperclip.agentId`, `paperclip.apiKey`
- **Env:** none
- **When off:** No board: issue state lives on GitHub labels only, and every handoff is the label change itself.

## Metrics (`metrics`)

Records how long each stage takes and how each item ends, for `npm run metrics:report`.

- **Roles:** `observer`
- **On when:** `metrics.enabled`
- **Config:** `metrics.enabled`, `metrics.path`, `metrics.retentionDays`
- **Env:** none
- **When off:** Nothing is recorded; the lifecycle is unchanged.

## Tech Lead (`tech-lead`)

An agent reviews each PR before it merges, approves or asks for changes, and merges on approval. It also approves release PRs.

- **Roles:** `reviewer`
- **On when:** `techLeadPath` is set (and `reviewEnabled` turns the review stage on)
- **Config:** `techLeadPath`, `reviewEnabled`
- **Env:** `TECHLEAD_GITHUB_KEY`
- **When off:** No automated review: each PR waits for a person to review and merge it, and the Foreman records the merge and carries on. The release stage cannot run (it needs a reviewer and a deployer), so a release PR waits for a person.

## SRE (`sre`)

An agent verifies each merged change in dev and, after release, in production, and deploys the release PR.

- **Roles:** `verifier`, `deployer`
- **On when:** `srePath` is set
- **Config:** `srePath`
- **Env:** `SRE_GITHUB_KEY`
- **When off:** No dev or production verification and no deploy: a merged issue goes straight on, and when no promote stage is configured either, it is commented and closed. A release PR waits for a person to merge it.

## QA (`qa`)

An agent runs visual and behaviour checks on a PR before it merges (`qaBeforeMerge`) or on dev after verification (`qaGate`), for the repos in `qaRepos`.

- **Roles:** `qa`
- **On when:** `qaPath` is set (covers `qaRepos`)
- **Config:** `qaPath`, `emRepoPath`, `qaRepos`, `qaGate`, `qaBeforeMerge`, `qaSecretsRunner`, `qaBearerKey`
- **Env:** `DEV_SESSION_MINT_KEY`
- **When off:** No QA gate: a PR moves on review and verification alone.

## Unstick (EM) (`em`)

An agent is called when work is stuck or held, to clear it or escalate it to a named owner.

- **Roles:** `unstick`
- **On when:** `emRepoPath` is set
- **Config:** `emRepoPath`, `unstickEscalationOwner`
- **Env:** `EM_GITHUB_TOKEN`
- **When off:** Stuck or held work stays where it is until a person clears it; nothing escalates it.
